tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open — Gauff beats Sonmez to reach Round 2; Fritz and Keys cruise; Cobolli rallies from two sets down; Rybakina races past Frodin as rain delays outdoor play nearly four hours • [SQUASH] London Classic Round 2 at Alexandra Palace — Coll meets Todd, El Hammamy vs Azman; PSA CEO Gough says tour competition at an all-time high • [BADMINTON] China Masters Day 2 in Shenzhen — Shi Yuqi exits to Loh Kean Yew; Feng/Huang survive 27-25 decider; top seeds Kim/Seo knocked out in men's doubles • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Veolia National Championships open in Cary — fall season starts with World Pickleball Rankings debut; Haworth top seed in men's singles • [TABLE TENNIS] ETTU Champions League Stage 2 draw set — eight Stage 1 survivors join top seeds; Europe Cup Men group-stage draw also completed

newsItems.title: Gauff and Fritz Advance at US Open
newsItems.excerpt: Coco Gauff opened with a straight-set win over Zeynep Sonmez, while Taylor Fritz and Madison Keys cruised through first-round matches — Flavio Cobolli rallied from two sets down as rain delayed outdoor play nearly four hours.

newsItems.title: London Classic Round 2 Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Gold London Squash Classic moves to Alexandra Palace for Round 2 — defending champion Paul Coll faces Sam Todd while top seeds Hania El Hammamy and Amina Orfi lead the women's draw at the iconic venue.

newsItems.title: PPA Fall Season Opens in Cary
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Pickleball National Championships kick off the Carvana PPA Tour fall slate in Cary, NC — debuting the unified World Pickleball Rankings after New Jersey 5s claimed their first MLP title.

newsItems.title: ETTU Stage 2 Draw Completed
newsItems.excerpt: Eight clubs advanced from HYLO Champions League Stage 1 in Lille and were paired with the top seeds — Saarbrücken drew Lille Metropole while Borussia Düsseldorf faces AS Pontoise Cergy in the Round of 16.
